Image Gallery

Image Gallery organises multiple images in grid layouts with optional captions, count badges, and thumbnail navigation.

Two-Column Grid

A simple two-column gallery layout.

HTML
<div class="zak-gallery zak-gallery-2col">
  <div class="zak-gallery-item"><img src="..." alt="..."></div>
  <div class="zak-gallery-item"><img src="..." alt="..."></div>
  <div class="zak-gallery-item"><img src="..." alt="..."></div>
  <div class="zak-gallery-item"><img src="..." alt="..."></div>
</div>

Gallery with Thumbnails

Show a grid of small thumbnail images that can be clicked to view the full image.

HTML
<div class="zak-gallery zak-gallery-thumbnails">
  <div class="zak-gallery-main">
    <img src="..." alt="...">
  </div>
  <div class="zak-gallery-thumbs">
    <button class="zak-gallery-thumb active"><img src="..." alt="..."></button>
    <button class="zak-gallery-thumb"><img src="..." alt="..."></button>
    <button class="zak-gallery-thumb"><img src="..." alt="..."></button>
  </div>
</div>

Gallery with Count Badge

Show an overlay badge indicating the number of images in a collection.

12 photos
8 photos
HTML
<div class="zak-gallery-item">
  <img src="..." alt="...">
  <span class="zak-badge zak-gallery-count">12 photos</span>
</div>

Gallery with Captions

Each image includes a caption overlay at the bottom.

Sunset Beach
Forest Trail
Desert Dunes
HTML
<div class="zak-gallery-item zak-gallery-item-caption">
  <img src="..." alt="...">
  <div class="zak-gallery-caption">Sunset Beach</div>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-galleryBase gallery container
.zak-gallery-2colTwo-column grid
.zak-gallery-3colThree-column grid
.zak-gallery-4colFour-column grid
.zak-gallery-masonryMasonry / Pinterest layout
.zak-gallery-thumbnailsThumbnail strip variant
.zak-gallery-itemIndividual gallery image wrapper
.zak-gallery-countOverlay count badge
.zak-gallery-item-captionItem with caption overlay
.zak-gallery-captionCaption text element

Accessibility

  • Each image must have a descriptive alt attribute.
  • Gallery items that are interactive (clickable thumbnails) need role="button" and tabindex="0".
  • Count badges should be linked to the gallery context via aria-label (e.g., "Gallery with 12 photos").
  • Caption overlays must maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the gradient background.
  • Use <figure> and <figcaption> for semantic caption content.
